image_description: A large sturgeon swimming in an aquarium tank, viewed through glass. The fish has a dark gray/brown dorsal side and lighter ventral side. Visible features include the elongated body, pointed snout, heterocercal tail, and rows of bony scutes along the lateral line and back. The background shows a sandy bottom with rocks and another fish in the distance.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated head with protrusible mouth on ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly elongated and the mouth position appears to be on the underside (ventral), consistent with sturgeon anatomy, though the exact protrusion is hard to see due to angle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Four barbels (sensory whiskers) anterior to mouth.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The resolution and water distortion obscure the fine details under the snout; barbels are not clearly visible or countable.
The snout is distinctly pointed and elongated, matching the diagnostic criteria.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated fusiform body with impressively large, extended proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The body is clearly elongated and fusiform, taking up a significant portion of the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Five rows of bony scutes (plates) along body instead of scales.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct rows of bony plates (scutes) are visible along the lateral line and dorsal ridge. While counting exactly five rows is difficult due to perspective, the presence of this key feature is confirmed.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Gray, brown, or black dorsally with lighter ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fish exhibits clear countershading: dark gray/brown on top and a lighter, whitish belly.
The tail fin is clearly asymmetrical, with the upper lobe being larger than the lower lobe, which is the definition of heterocercal.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight glare and reflections on the aquarium glass create minor visual noise, but this is a physical property of the scene, not an AI generation artifact. No structural melting or fusion detected.
